name: Same Sky PJ-002A 2.0 mm DC power jack (2.5 A)
//: The plain PJ-002A: the same drawing, pad for pad, as the PJ-002AH the irrigation controller's 12 V inlet chose, at half the current rating. Same Sky (formerly CUI Devices) datasheet rev 1.10 dated 03/11/2025, product page read the same day. Read 2026-09-29; kept because it is the drop-in substitute when the AH is out of stock, and a substitution should be made knowing what it costs. Rails are named as the irrigation design names them ('12v', 'ground'); a catalog record carries the rail it was researched for.
//why_not: Rated 2.5 A where the board's load is 'about 2 A' unmeasured plus the buck - too thin a margin when the same footprint is sold at 5 A for a few crowns more.

power.note: Terminal 1, the centre pin. Carries whatever the adapter puts on its centre contact; the jack does not enforce centre-positive. Unregulated and unfused.
Terminal 2, the sleeve contact the plug's barrel rides on. The single point where the supply's return meets board ground.

unused_pins.note: Terminal 3, the switch contact. Read off the datasheet schematic: it rests against terminal 2 while no plug is in and the plug's barrel pushes them apart, so with nothing plugged in it sits at ground potential. Leave it open; never tie it to the 12 V rail.

//pin_order: Pads numbered as the datasheet numbers the terminals: 1 centre pin, 2 sleeve, 3 switch - read off the drawing's schematic symbol and PCB layout, never from a table, so unverified. Meter the real part before ordering a board.
footprint_note: pinrow3 is a 2.54 mm header, kept only so the pad count matches pin_order. The real layout, read off the PJ-002A drawing (p.2): pads 1 and 2 on a 6.0 mm pitch across the plug axis, pad 3 on the axis 4.7 mm behind them, slots about 1.0 x 3.0 mm; 10.7 mm of body on the board behind a 3.5 mm lip that overhangs the edge; barrel axis 6.5 mm above the board. KiCad's Connector_BarrelJack.pretty/BarrelJack_Horizontal.kicad_mod has pad 1 at (0,0), pad 2 at (-6,0), pad 3 at (-3,4.7) with 1 x 3 mm oval drills - the same positions, compared by eye. Same Sky's own footprint download: https://www.sameskydevices.com/product/resource/pcbfootprint/pj-002a (not fetched).

body_mm.note: Product page: 'Dimensions LxWxH (mm): 14.4 x 9 x 11' as text; the drawing agrees (9.00 across, 14.40 along the axis of which 3.50 is the overhanging lip and 10.70 on the board, 11.00 tall). width = across the axis, height = along it, the whole 14.4.

host_requirements: The jack does not enforce polarity: a centre-negative adapter puts -12 V on the rail. Reverse-polarity protection after it, centre-positive symbol on the silkscreen.
Fuse or current-limit right after it, at or below 2.5 A - which is also the reason it was not chosen.
Terminal 3 is at ground potential with no plug inserted; leave it unconnected.
Board-edge part: 3.5 mm lip overhang, barrel axis 6.5 mm above the board, plug inserts 9.5 mm - the enclosure needs a hole on that axis and clearance in front.

rated_current_a.note: Datasheet: 'rated input current 2.5 A max', feature line '2.5 A rating'; product page 'Current Rating (A): 2.5'. Web-search summaries called this a 5 A part; the datasheet does not.
rated_current_a.why_it_matters: The whole board's current crosses this contact pair; this is the number the PJ-002AH was preferred on.

center_pin_diameter_mm.note: Datasheet feature line '2.0 mm center pin'; product page 'Inner Diameter (mm): 2'.

jack_opening_mm.note: Product page 'Outer Diameter (mm): 6.5'; the drawing shows Ø6.50 at the face.

mating_plug_od_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the drawing ('MATING PLUG Ø5.5'); the adapter's plug must be 5.5 x 2.1 mm.

insulation_resistance_mohm_min.note: Datasheet 'insulation resistance at 500 Vdc, 100 MΩ min'.

terminal_count.note: Materials table lists terminal 1, 2, 3; product page '2 conductors, 1 internal switch'. TME's 'PIN: 2' counts conductors.

pad_1_to_pad_2_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the recommended PCB layout (3.00 + 3.00 either side of the axis); where the footprint's pads 1 and 2 go.

pad_3_setback_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the drawing ('4.70±0.20'); where the switch pad goes.

barrel_axis_height_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the drawing ('6.50±0.10'); the enclosure hole is centred this far above the board.

sourcing.note: TME symbol PJ002A; description 'Konektor: napájecí DC; zásuvka; 2,5A; 24V; PIN: 2; THT; 2mm'. JSON-LD: priceCurrency CZK, lowPrice 9.15, highPrice 15.092, InStock, inventoryLevel 1200; the visible '0 skladem' contradicts it. The English page shows 1,200 units at USD 0.36-0.58. VAT status not stated on what was read. TME answers 403 to a bare HEAD, so this URL is here and not in sources.
